question.problem: Let $A(1,0,1,0)$ and $B(-1,4,0,-1).$ Find the cosine of the angle $∠AOB$, where $O(0,0,0,0)$ is the origin.
question.worked_solution:
First, let

$$
\begin{aligned}a=\overset{\to }{OA}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,b=\overset{\to }{OB}=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 4 \\ 0 \\ -1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Also, let $\theta =m∠AOB$ be the angle between the vectors $a$ and $b.$ Then, we can find $\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta $ using the following formula:

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta  & =\frac{a\cdot b}{‖a‖\,‖b‖} \\  & =\frac{{a}_{1}{b}_{1}+{a}_{2}{b}_{2}+{a}_{3}{b}_{3}+{a}_{4}{b}_{4}}{\sqrt{{a}_{1}^{2}+{a}_{2}^{2}+{a}_{3}^{2}+{a}_{4}^{2}}\,\sqrt{{b}_{1}^{2}+{b}_{2}^{2}+{b}_{3}^{2}+{b}_{4}^{2}}} \\  & =\frac{1\cdot (-1)+0\cdot 4+1\cdot 0+0\cdot (-1)}{\sqrt{{1}^{2}+{0}^{2}+{1}^{2}+{0}^{2}}\,\sqrt{(-1)^{2}+{4}^{2}+{0}^{2}+(-1)^{2}}} \\  & =\frac{-1}{\sqrt{2}\cdot \sqrt{18}} \\  & =\frac{-1}{\sqrt{36}} \\  & =-\frac{1}{6}\end{aligned}
$$
